finding: The OOM interrupted services outside this task. Their replacement processes are currently active/running. This is process-level recovery evidence only.

container_observation.note: The 12:59 restart belongs to this task and is documented maintenance. One other retained container has a later start and accumulated restarts; no relationship to the OOM was established and its operation was not investigated.

task_owned_restart.reason: Authorized task maintenance, documented separately; not evidence of collateral OOM impact.

limitations: No application requests or semantic health checks were performed. Active/running does not establish correct application operation or absence of other effects.
Current metadata and the empty Docker event window do not establish complete history, deleted-container state, or absence of interrupted child processes.
The retained kernel victims for this incident were in host user-session cgroups; no container victim was identified in that retained log.
Recovery mechanism, exact downtime and possible lost work were not determined.
operations: Read-only process/service/container inspection; no restart, recovery, deployment, credential inspection or configuration changes.

local_evidence.availability: local-only; exact service names, PIDs and container identifiers are retained only under artifacts
